verdict: Use the separate versioned binding receipt. Do not migrate the occurrence.
why_not_migration: validate-occurrence is an exact key set shared by v1 and v2; a v3 needs a per-schema key set in close_retention, and every validated reader inherits it (interpretation_evidence, close retention block, cohort close).

attempt_learning.clj:81 refuses anything not literally :wm/action-transition-occurrence-v2 (:occurrence-v2-required), so a v3 occurrence turns every learning receipt into a refusal until that literal and contract (attempt_learning.clj:30,37) are versioned too.

Occurrence equality is the join at attempt_learning.clj:83 and :90 and the dedup key in learning_trial_ledger.clj; changing the occurrence map changes the identity those already-banked rows were keyed under, so legacy ledger rows need explicit mapping.

The occurrence is minted for repair routes as well, which have no declared-effect record; a v3 occurrence would need an optional digest field, which is exactly the ad hoc relaxation the request forbids.

binding_receipt.occurrence_digest: sha256 over printed [:wm/action-transition-occurrence-digest-v1 (action-identity/canonical occurrence)]. Use a new domain tag; do not call action-identity/digest on the occurrence, because that tags the bytes as an action identity.
binding_receipt.construction: Pure function in a new namespace beside declared_effect_record (not in the runner). Exact-map validation on its input and output, mirroring close-retention refuse!/exact-map! style. Minted once per attempt via compare-and-set! on its own atom, as mint-action-occurrence-once! does.

invariant: For an attempt on an ordinary (non-repair) route, an occurrence O exists if and only if exactly one binding B exists with: B.occurrence/digest = occ-digest(O); B.occurrence/key = select-keys of O; B.target = (:target (:action/value O)) = selection cell :selected-mission = record :target; B.declared-effect/digest = verify-record(R) where R is the record frozen in the selection cell; (:eligible (:admission R)) is true; B.declared-effect/source equals R :declaration {:path :sha256}; B.base-revision equals R :base-revision. The action value, action digest and selection/scoring certificate are not read or altered by the binding.
ordering: S1 selection cell (runner ~7087): build-record and verify-record; freeze the record itself (or a retained file + sha) in the selection cell under its own key, not inside :controller-decision or the selection certificate. If (:eligible (:admission R)) is false, throw before mint with failure-kind :no-declared-effect (or the record's first admission refusal), failure-stage :selection-admission. Result: an inadmissible ordinary target never gets an occurrence, so the 'if and only if' does not need a gap case.

S3 bind immediately after mint and before the d-task/context reset at 7211 and before interpretation/dispatch. Persist to <attempt>/retained/declared-effect-binding.edn; keep {:path :sha256}. Any exception here fails the attempt with :declared-effect-binding-failed; nothing downstream may run on an occurrence without its binding.
